description: Reads one WhatsApp number in one of four views. summary: its status, quality, limits and onboarding summary. import_progress: the progress of importing the number’s chat history. connect_steps and attempt_steps: an ordered list of the steps of connecting it, each with its state, time and outcome, which explains where a connect that stopped stopped. Read-only.

id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection) id; for view attempt_steps, the connect attempt id.

view.description: summary for the number with its onboarding summary; import_progress for how far the chat-history import has come; connect_steps for the steps of how the number was connected, with their times and outcomes; attempt_steps for the same steps of one connect attempt, named by its attempt id.

name: get_number
title: Read one WhatsApp number
